key_provisions_or_claims: Remove Annex I and amend Article 3 AI definition; extend scope to legacy AI systems and Annex IX large-scale IT systems
Broaden Article 5 prohibitions: harmful manipulation, social scoring by private actors, biometric and emotion recognition bans
Add EGTAI requirements (human agency, privacy, fairness, explainability, wellbeing) to high-risk requirements
Reserve certain decisions to humans ('human-in-command'), e.g. judiciary, healthcare, labour
Make third-party conformity assessment obligatory for high-risk AI and add complaints and redress mechanism
annotation.summary_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Commission's proposed AI Act. It welcomes the rights-centred, risk-based approach but recommends a clearer AI definition, wider prohibitions (social scoring, biometric and emotion recognition), added trustworthy-AI requirements, human-in-command, mandatory third-party conformity assessment, and a redress mechanism.
annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
